name: experience-layer-remove-phase4-cross-project
title: Experience Layer plan: remove Phase 4 / L4 cross-project aggregation (per-project only by design)
description: Documentation-only edit to docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md: remove the L4 Cross-project aggregation Architecture bullet and the Phase 4 Roadmap bullet, and reword the remaining cross-project references (principle 5, the problem-statement footprint mention, the not-to-do line) to state per-project-only learning by design. The user decided cross-project aggregation must not be built: Lattice is a per-project tool, and cross-project learning would pollute single-project review and weaken the auditable local lineage. The Phase 1 'deterministic local signature' aggregation concept (distinct from the two-layer cross-project framing) is kept intact. No source code changes; the built Phases 1a-3 are already per-project.
